page.title: The Mimic Roblox Quiz: 15 Questions on Control's Book
page.description_md: Think you know Control's Book in The Mimic? Take 15 random questions about its routes, puzzles, enemy behavior and boss fights, with five questions at each difficulty.
page.seo_description: Test your knowledge of Control's Book in Roblox The Mimic with 15 random questions on routes, puzzles, patrols and boss fights, from easy to hard.
